problem: How do metallic glasses relax at room temperature over very long timescales?
mechanism_or_method: Modified molecular dynamics reaching room temperature shows stretched exponential decay with beta=3/7 from defect elimination via localized strains, checked by stress relaxation.
limitation: Universality shown for a limited set of metallic glasses; simulation timescales still extrapolated.

problem: Can junction-free interwoven micro-knotted architectures improve energy absorption and extensibility over woven and monolithic lattices?
mechanism_or_method: Micro-knots as building blocks of hierarchical networks, with tensile tests and an analytical overhand-knot model showing shape-retaining deformation via friction.
limitation: Microscale specimens; scalability and cyclic durability not established.
decision_relevance: Favors knotted architectures for lightweight energy-absorbing structures.

problem: Does phonon Poiseuille flow exist in graphitic materials at elevated temperatures?
mechanism_or_method: Microscale suspended-ribbon thermal transport platform combined with kinetic theory using first-principles inputs and an occurrence criterion for anisotropic solids.
limitation: Observed only up to 90 K in a micron-scale suspended ribbon.

problem: Can ultrabroadband deep-subwavelength sound absorption and reflection control be achieved below 1 kHz?
mechanism_or_method: Small layers of air plasma whose dynamics are tuned to interact with sound, giving perfect absorption over two frequency decades at thickness lambda/1000.
limitation: Plasma generation power, stability and safety for practical noise control not addressed in abstract.
decision_relevance: Offers thin low-frequency noise absorber alternative to porous materials and resonators.

problem: Can hydrogels autonomously capture, deliver cargo and avoid obstacles under constant stimuli without stepwise control?
mechanism_or_method: Two spiropyran monomers in random networks give photoregulated charge reversal; electric field gradients from dielectric inhomogeneity steer locomotion.
limitation: Demonstrated in lab setups with simple obstacles; speed and scalability unclear.

problem: How do phase transformations control transient strain and residual stress evolution during 3D printing?
mechanism_or_method: Operando neutron diffraction combined with infrared and simulation data tracks lattice strain linked to FCC/BCC phase boundary motion.
limitation: Single steel composition and a neutron facility requirement limit generality.
decision_relevance: Guides tailoring of residual stress in AM parts via phase transformation control.

object: free molecular gas flow in nanopores
problem: How can Knudsen theory be generalized to gas transport with mixed specular and diffuse wall reflections?
mechanism_or_method: Generalized Knudsen theory with tunable boundary conditions, avoiding the Smoluchowski divergence, validated by molecular dynamics simulations.
limitation: Validated only against molecular dynamics, not against new experiments.
decision_relevance: Improves gas flow rate prediction in atomically smooth nanochannels.

problem: How can mercury be captured from SO2-containing flue gas with a self-sustained adsorbent?
mechanism_or_method: Low-temperature sulfur CVD converts SO2 with H2S into deposited sulfur forming unsaturated polysulfides on metal sulfides, supported by DFT.
limitation: Lab-scale tests; performance in real flue gas conditions and long-term operation unproven.

problem: Can ordered periodic mechanical lattices create their own disorder and encode history-dependent memory?
mechanism_or_method: Design inspired by frustrated artificial spin ice maps incompatibility to continuous mechanical degrees of freedom, giving non-Abelian, history-dependent responses.
limitation: Appears to be a design concept without extensive physical validation of memory readout.

problem: Can a lightweight single-phase Al-based complex concentrated alloy with high specific strength be formed?
mechanism_or_method: High-pressure, high-temperature synthesis reduces solute atomic size and electronegativity differences, enabling single phase with solid solution and nanoscale chemical fluctuation strengthening.
limitation: High-pressure synthesis yields small samples; scalability to bulk components is unclear.

problem: Can metamaterials combine programmable shape, wide temperature range, fast response and actuation?
mechanism_or_method: Assembling thermostat bimetal strips into metamaterials with programmable thermal deformation, giving about 30% thermal strain and tunable bandgap.
limitation: Lab-scale specimens; durability under thermal cycling and heat transfer constraints not discussed.
decision_relevance: Supports bimetal metamaterials for thermal actuators and tunable vibration isolation.

problem: How can soft wearable actuators deliver large out-of-plane tactile feedback for extended reality?
mechanism_or_method: Millimeter-scale multilayer dielectric elastomer actuators with thickness-varying structure achieve large out-of-plane displacement and force without rigid or liquid biasing.
limitation: Perception study scale and high-voltage operation for wearables not detailed.

problem: Can non-twisted fibers deliver large tensile stroke and work capacity as artificial muscles?
mechanism_or_method: Spun MXene/cellulose fibers with axially stacked nanosheets contract 21% on heating through reversible hydrogen bond orientation changes.
limitation: Thermal actuation requires heating to 125 C; cycle life and response speed limits unclear.

problem: How can rigid and flexible components be integrated reliably into highly stretchable substrates despite modulus mismatch?
mechanism_or_method: Bioinspired interface-engineered flexible island with mechanical interlocking, demonstrated with LEDs, solar cells and a workout monitor.
limitation: Long-term fatigue and large-scale manufacturing not assessed in abstract.

problem: Can galvanic leaching recover battery metals without pre-crushing or added reductants at lower entropy cost?
mechanism_or_method: Cathode particles self-assemble with aluminium foil to form a primary cell whose potential difference reduces and dissolves metals.
limitation: Lab-scale leaching; assessments rely on modeled industrial scale-up assumptions.

problem: Can trace CO2 be selectively removed from acetylene with a low-cost scalable adsorbent?
mechanism_or_method: Polyethyleneimine loaded on commercial HP20 resin captures CO2 by dual chemisorption/physisorption, validated in pilot-scale pressure-temperature swing adsorption.
limitation: Pilot test limited to 2 kg adsorbent and one gas ratio.

problem: How can ultrastrong gels retain stretchability instead of becoming brittle?
mechanism_or_method: Hyperhysteresis-mediated single pre-stretching training with deep eutectic solvent in PVA forms hierarchical nanofibrils, plus a second chemical network.
limitation: Properties measured on lab specimens; long-term stability of solvent-based gels is unclear.

problem: How can a deformable metasurface keep stable electromagnetic performance under shape changes?
mechanism_or_method: Conformal sensor array senses geometry; a neural network adaptively encodes bias voltages to compensate deformation.
limitation: Demonstrated for limited deformation ranges in the lab.

problem: How will Amazon windthrow disturbance change with storm frequency under global warming?
mechanism_or_method: Empirical relationship maps convective available potential energy from Earth system models to large windthrow patterns, projected under SSP585.
limitation: Empirical mapping extrapolated to end of century; mechanistic wind-to-mortality link remains absent.

object: elastic surface waves on patterned surfaces
problem: Can topological pumping of elastic surface waves be realized using a synthetic dimension?
mechanism_or_method: Resonant pillar arrays with slowly varying coupling bridges; tight-binding and WKB analysis predict pumping, validated numerically and experimentally.
limitation: Demonstrated on small laboratory samples with narrow-band operation.

problem: Can a light-driven soft actuator achieve fast rotary flight?
mechanism_or_method: Maple-seed-inspired photothermal graphene/agar/silk fibroin film forms an airscrew with jet propulsion, spinning about 7200 rpm under NIR light.
limitation: Requires strong NIR illumination; payload and flight endurance are limited.

problem: How can aqueous ethanol be upgraded to long-chain alcohols with noble-metal-free catalysts?
mechanism_or_method: Sulfur modification controllably exposes Ni sites that stabilize aldehyde intermediates and promote direct carbon chain growth.
limitation: Catalyst stability and scale-up in aqueous phase not detailed.

problem: How can overhanging and thin-walled soft scaffolds be made without collapse during fabrication?
mechanism_or_method: Magnet-assisted fabrication uses a magnetic field for shape morphing and remote temporary support, demonstrated with vascular-like branching and cardiomyocyte-driven walkers.
limitation: Resolution and biological function over long culture times not established.

problem: Can sub-10 nm membranes have connective adaptive channels for fast water transport and graded sieving?
mechanism_or_method: Free-interface-confined self-assembly and crosslinking of organic cage networks, with channel chemistry tuned by anion exchange including light-responsive anions.
limitation: Large-area stability and long-term separation performance not shown.

problem: How do suspended monolayer graphene and MoS2 undergo stepwise mechanical instabilities?
mechanism_or_method: Push-to-shear loading tunes wrinkling-splitting-smoothing; instabilities governed by geometry, pretension and elastic nonlinearity, enabling bending stiffness measurement.
limitation: Limited to graphene and MoS2 with specific suspended geometries.

problem: Why does a Mo alloy with irregular La2O3 nanoparticles show exceptional low-temperature ductility?
mechanism_or_method: Rotary swaging creates irregular particles; rare-earth electronic structure promotes oxygen vacancies, interface amorphization and multiple dislocation sources, enhancing plasticity.
limitation: Single alloy system; mechanism partly inferred from calculations and microscopy.
decision_relevance: Suggests oxide particle shaping route to improve ductility of refractory Mo alloys.

object: natural hydrogen in Songliao Basin gas deposit
problem: What are the origins, conversion and production rates of natural hydrogen in a volcanic-bearing sedimentary basin?
mechanism_or_method: Gas composition and stable carbon, hydrogen and helium isotopes from field samples quantify radiolysis, water-rock and mantle hydrogen sources and Fischer-Tropsch conversion.
limitation: Single basin; reserve estimates rest on assumed generation models.
decision_relevance: Informs exploration targeting for natural hydrogen in volcanic basins.

object: nematic fluid mesophase with unipolar and bipolar order
problem: Can designable polar textures be patterned at large scale in a fluid for miniaturized nonlinear optics?
mechanism_or_method: A newly discovered mesophase with modulated apolar and polar orientational order enables defect-free polar patterning and compact nonlinear vectorial beam generation.
limitation: Material-specific mesophase; device-level efficiency and stability not described.

problem: What network patterns arise in supramolecular fiber/covalent polymer composite hydrogels and what controls them?
mechanism_or_method: In situ real-time confocal imaging reveals four network patterns governed by formation order and inter-fiber interactions.
limitation: Few model gel systems; link to mechanical properties not quantified in abstract.

problem: How can side reactions such as deep hydrogenation be suppressed while keeping hydrogen activation?
mechanism_or_method: Alkenyl-type carbon ligands form homogeneous-like Pd-alkene metallacycles on Pd-Fe, donating electrons to Pd and weakening Pd-reactant interaction.
limitation: Tested on model reactions only (diphenyl ether, acetylene hydrogenation).

object: layered structures inspected by terahertz imaging
problem: How can hidden structure be extracted from multilayer samples at ultralow signal-to-noise ratio?
mechanism_or_method: THz time-domain spectroscopy using local symmetry of reflected pulses to locate layers plus spatiotemporal statistical processing to enhance contrast.
limitation: Requires THz spectroscopy setup; tested on paper stacks and a few artifacts.
decision_relevance: Enables noninvasive debonding inspection of multilayer coatings and cultural artifacts.

problem: Can one sensing element decode bending, compression, stretch and temperature changes together?
mechanism_or_method: Light chromaticity and intensity through patterned elastomer doped with functional dyes maps deformation and temperature modes to sensor output.
limitation: Temperature sensing is binary; robustness in real robots not quantified.

problem: Can GaN doping raise pyroelectric energy harvesting from low-grade temperature variations?
mechanism_or_method: GaN dopant boosts Ga-Ti-O vibrations, improving thermal conductivity and pyroelectric coefficient, giving 80 uJ/cm3 under 2 C variation.
limitation: Energy density is small and requires very high 600 MOhm load resistance.

problem: How can soft mechanoelectrical generators deliver high current at low-frequency motion?
mechanism_or_method: Engineered structural and chemical asymmetry (relief structures, asymmetric electrode adsorption, ion diffusivity) amplifies mechanoionic current to 4 mA.
limitation: Lab compression tests; long-term durability and hydration stability not described.

problem: Can one material integrate sensing, signal processing and actuation for adaptive interactive systems?
mechanism_or_method: Liquid crystal polymer film deforms anisotropically under touch heat and switches an electric circuit, enabling cascaded feedback among units.
limitation: Slow thermal response and small demonstrator systems.

problem: What structure maximizes mechanical energy absorbing efficiency, found through a self-driving lab?
mechanism_or_method: Human-guided self-driving lab runs over 25,000 physical experiments with Bayesian optimization in an 11-dimensional parameter space.
limitation: Single polymer and geometry family; results tied to the printing and testing platform.
decision_relevance: Provides designs and principles for tough energy-absorbing protective structures.

problem: How can microbot collectives reconfigure robustly and cooperate without continuous external stimuli?
mechanism_or_method: Two-photon polymerization of microbots from magnetic photoresist, hydrogel and metal nanoparticles; magnetic and light fields drive reversible assembly.
limitation: Demonstrated at microscale in lab liquid environments; in vivo operation unproven.

problem: Can a soft display morph quickly into seamless 3D shapes with multimodal tactile feedback?
mechanism_or_method: PVC gel composite with dielectric liquid and electrode array; electrostatic zipping reconfigures electrohydraulic channels.
limitation: High-voltage electrohydraulic operation; scaling of resolution and lifetime not shown.

problem: Can metal-organic cages improve microporosity of polymer membranes for CO2 separation?
mechanism_or_method: Synthesized cages with apertures between CO2 and N2/CH4 are dispersed in PIM-1, modulating chain packing and permeability.
limitation: Aging of PIM-1 membranes and performance with real mixed gases not addressed.

problem: How can classical mechanism design be combined with soft materials for robust dexterous legged robots?
mechanism_or_method: Multi-extruder printing blends thermoplastics of varying hardness into monolithic joint-like mechanisms with encoder-based closed-loop control.
limitation: Single legged platform tested; payload and durability limits not quantified in abstract.
decision_relevance: Supports multi-material printed mechanisms for low-cost robust field robots.

problem: Can a low-cost hydrogel reach high strength, low friction and wear resistance like cartilage?
mechanism_or_method: Concrete-like structure of PVA particles and PVA/PEG fibers gives high compressive and tensile strength and low friction under submersion.
limitation: Lab-scale testing; long-term wear and biological compatibility not established.

problem: How can magnetization profiles and morphology be designed efficiently for desired shape morphing despite coupled design space?
mechanism_or_method: Stochastic design alterations guided by a predictive neural network with low-cost simulations optimize magnetization and geometry, with robotic demonstrations.
limitation: Relies on simulation fidelity and physical fabrication of magnetized structures for validation.
decision_relevance: Enables automated design of magnetic soft robots instead of trial and error.

problem: How does tailored micro-meso-macroporous channel structure affect moisture-based power generation?
mechanism_or_method: Freeze-assisted salting-out builds bilayer hydrogel membranes with oriented channels and asymmetric charge, with performance following the Hofmeister series.
limitation: Microwatt-scale output tested at controlled humidity; outdoor variability not assessed.

problem: Can heterostructured nanosheet membranes give fast selective hydrogen transport?
mechanism_or_method: Pyro-layering of chitosan-derived graphene between boron nitride nanosheets forms 3 angstrom slit nanochannels, giving H2 permeability of 849 Barrer and H2/CO2 selectivity of 290.
limitation: Performance under humid or industrial mixed-gas conditions not established.

object: laser powder bed fusion process parameters
problem: Can relative density above 98% be predicted across different powder materials?
mechanism_or_method: XGBoost on powder properties and process conditions with sigmoid output transform and SHAP analysis, validated on 316L, AlSi10Mg and a medium entropy alloy.
limitation: Validated on three materials; density only, not other quality metrics.
decision_relevance: Guides selection of LPBF process parameters for dense parts across materials.

problem: Can light tune gliding flight modes of miniature passive fliers contactlessly?
mechanism_or_method: Azobenzene-crosslinked liquid crystal network films give reversible bistable photochemical shape morphing in samara-like and other gliders.
limitation: Tuning requires illumination; control precision outdoors with wind is limited.

problem: What are the advances in olfactory feedback technologies and wearables for immersive VR/AR?
mechanism_or_method: Review of olfactory feedback technologies and wearable device evolution for virtual and augmented reality interaction.
limitation: Review scope only; no new data or quantitative comparison indicated.

problem: How can body-heat thermogalvanic devices achieve both high Carnot-relative efficiency and mechanical strength?
mechanism_or_method: Thermosensitive crystallization and salting-out in an ion-transport highway give 8.53% efficiency, 70.65 MJ/m3 toughness and about 900% elongation.
limitation: Efficiency measured near room temperature in lab; absolute power is small.

object: flow boiling on structured tube surfaces
problem: What mechanisms drive flow boiling heat transfer enhancement on micro- and nanostructured surfaces?
mechanism_or_method: In situ boroscopy visualizes bubble dynamics in etched aluminum and copper tubes; mercury porosimetry links pore size distribution to thermal performance.
limitation: Saturated flow conditions and two tube materials only.
decision_relevance: Guides surface structure and pore design for two-phase heat exchangers.

problem: Can electroluminescent fibres be bright, self-healing and magnetically actuatable?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrogel-clad ionotronic fibre with nickel core reaches 1068 cd/m2, heals across all layers and moves under magnetic fields.
limitation: Hydrogel-based fibres may suffer water loss; performance in textile integration untested.

object: CO2 adsorption in calcium hydroxide mesopores
problem: At what relative humidity is CO2 intake in mesoporous alkaline waste materials maximal?
mechanism_or_method: Atomistic simulation of CO2 adsorption in metastable water films in calcium hydroxide identifies optimal humidity conditions.
limitation: Atomistic models of idealized pores may not capture real waste material heterogeneity.

problem: How can continuous vertical COF channels be built in mixed-matrix membranes for CO2 separation?
mechanism_or_method: Reverse filling: ice-templated oriented COF nanosheet scaffold subsequently filled with polyimide, giving CO2 permeability of 972 Barrer and CO2/CH4 selectivity 58.
limitation: Performance shown for specific gas pairs; industrial mixed-gas validation unclear.

problem: How can metamaterials achieve extreme macroscale impact mitigation through dynamic toughening?
mechanism_or_method: Shell-based microarchitecture in additively manufactured low-SFE medium-entropy alloy amplifies dynamic stress, activating multiscale toughening and prolonged strain hardening.
limitation: Specific alloy and architecture; scalability and cost of AM alloy parts unclear.
decision_relevance: Favors shell lattices of low-SFE alloys for lightweight impact protection.

object: photothermal hydrogel ion pump for lithium extraction
problem: How can lithium ion sieve adsorbents be made stable and efficient for seawater lithium extraction?
mechanism_or_method: Interpenetrating hydrogel confining HMO with adsorption-responsive swelling, Mn chelation and solar photothermal convection, raising kinetics 2.9-fold.
limitation: Capacity of 34 mg/g tested in lab; real seawater long-term cycling not detailed.

problem: Can moist energy harvesting be coupled with electromagnetic interference shielding in one film?
mechanism_or_method: Polyanion/polypyrrole polymer diodes with tuned molecular interactions and porosity create ion gradients giving rectenna effect and shielding with 480 uW/cm2 output.
limitation: Humidity-dependent operation; long-term stability in real wireless devices not shown.

object: high-entropy alloy nanorings for oxygen reduction
problem: Can breaking surface symmetry release stress and tune compressive strain to boost ORR activity?
mechanism_or_method: PtPdFeCoNi HEA nanorings with terrace-type defects release surface stress, lowering the Pt d-band center for faster oxygen reduction.
limitation: Half-cell activity only; durability and full fuel cell performance not shown in abstract.

problem: Can battery degradation, knee point and end of life be predicted from the first 5-30% of cycles?
mechanism_or_method: BatteryGPT: GPT autoregressively predicts full-lifecycle charging data, then a state-of-health estimator maps it to ageing features.
limitation: Validated on lab cycling data; generalization to field battery usage unclear.
decision_relevance: Enables earlier battery maintenance and recycling decisions from early charging data.

problem: What is the microscopic origin of the boson peak as liquids vitrify?
mechanism_or_method: Depolarised Raman isolates the boson peak, matched with excess heat capacity; wide-angle x-ray scattering and MD link it to clusters of about 20 over-coordinated molecules.
limitation: Shown for liquids of highly symmetric molecules; generality to other glasses uncertain.

problem: How can photopolymers achieve high crosslinking with low shrinkage stress?
mechanism_or_method: Upconversion particles emit gradient UV-vis light, creating domain-limited photopolymerization that delays gelation and releases shrinkage stress before network percolation.
limitation: Needs NIR source and upconversion particles; depth and scale of curing not assessed.

problem: How does sample size affect vitrification kinetics and atomic mobility in metallic glasses?
mechanism_or_method: Fast scanning calorimetry over wide cooling rates and frequencies on Au- and Pt-based glasses of decreasing micrometer size.
limitation: Only Au- and Pt-based glasses at micrometer scale; mechanism of size dependence not fully resolved.
